reviewedBoundaries: Committed Input save/detach acknowledgements preserve exact durable values and revisions when optional composer projection fails or times out; uncertain attachment classification fails closed. Strict canonical, operator, and precommit validation remains before mutation.

Successful native claim and activation synchronously spawn the existing executor before optional Product reread. Fallback carries the exact successfully claimed interaction and PreparedInteraction child identity, never inferred accepted output or reusable execution authority. Optional invocation/input projections cannot reject the irreversible successful handoff.
Renderer returns the successful POST acknowledgement independently of optional refresh failure; durable calls remain single use and recovery/refusal flags do not grant unconditional retries.

Imported source mappings use actual canonical accepted source/action/presenting identities within the unique thread import. Action mapping requires exactly one matching accepted canonical action; portable IDs remain inert reading identity and never native capability.

Native Current resolution validates source, frozen action and key, child, lifecycle, and accepted current root. Graph-only synthetic views remain read only with no Product receipt, accepted Navigate relation, or synthetic Product URL.

Source/Back/Forward/Current retain the exact invoking source path and selected node. Changed or missing native evidence restores that saved source rather than an unrelated later human turn; asynchronous refresh respects reading intent and preserves stored composer context.

Graph-owned imported Succeeded without Product result uses actual retained Returned evidence only when coherent with Current. A nonnull missing Product result or inconsistent Returned root refuses resolution rather than manufacturing a result.

Native child root SVG access uses the real Product source interaction and exact unique native invocation/current/accepted Navigate Expand root association. Wrong source, node, layer, and asset are refused; pinned bytes retain hash and media validation. Succeeded root enrichment reads actual accepted output in one transaction; Advance, Stopped, and Failed do not infer a root action.

Workspace recreation transfers plain occurrence-keyed local Input stages and edit epochs, including unblurred implicit values and independent Undo baselines. It does not transfer controller promises, captured submissions, execution authority, or input draft revision. Authoritative persisted draft state reloads; entering and leaving Current does not accept or mutate the inputs.
Public-share snapshot regression and asset delivery do not gain execution grants. No test was deleted or retired in this reviewed delta.
